mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversation (type, group_name, single_key, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{type}, #{groupName}, #{singleKey}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, type, group_name, single_key, create_by, last_msg_id, last_time, create_time FROM chat_conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT conversation_id, type, group_name, single_key, create_by, last_msg_id, last_time, create_time FROM chat_conversation WHERE single_key = #{singleKey}

SELECT c.conversation_id, c.type, c.group_name, c.last_time, (SELECT msg.content FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY msg.msg_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND msg.msg_id > m.last_read_msg_id AND msg.sender_user_id <> #{userId}) AS unread_count FROM chat_conversation c JOIN chat_conversation_member m ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_time, c.create_time) DESC
